summary: Niki BioSolutions filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market equity offering of up to $1,396,000 in common stock under a Sales Agreement dated October 9, 2026 with H.C. Wainwright and Brookline Capital Markets as selling managers. Sales occur at prevailing market prices on Nasdaq under symbol NIKI; last reported price was $4.23 on October 8, 2026. Managers receive 3.0% of gross proceeds. The capacity reflects the General Instruction I.B.6 one-third public float limit, following $2,000,000 sold in the prior twelve months. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and ATM usage pace.
